title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression CI gates and metrics integration
author: Maya Chen
description: Add per-prompt regression CI gates to the eval-harness and integrate per-prompt metrics into the CI pipeline. Motivation: teams have asked for finer-grained quality gating so a regression on a small but critical prompt can fail CI independently of aggregated metrics. This change introduces a configurable per-prompt baseline/threshold mechanism, a CI hook that runs evals on merged model candidates, and dashboards/metrics emit for per-prompt pass/fail counts. Checklist: - Add config surface (.eval/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml) with optional Linear keys for tracking - Implement gating logic in eval-harness runner with clear failure messages - Add a lightweight CI hook (ci/eval_gate.sh) that posts results as annotations and fails on threshold breaches - Emit per-prompt metrics (eval.prompt_score, eval.prompt_pass) to Datadog and the internal metrics gateway - Docs: update eval-harness README and quickstart with examples and guidance on setting thresholds - Add unit tests and CI job that runs on PRs and on nightly model candidate builds Note: this PR intentionally keeps the thresholding opt-in (default: disabled) and provides a `--strict` flag for teams who want fail-fast behavior. Related: ENG-2148 (per-prompt gating RFC), SUP-4321 (customer report of prompt-level regressions).

review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Nice work — the gating logic is straightforward and the opt-in default is the right call. I left one minor comment about logging the prompt slice that failed so SRE can triage faster.
Maya Chen (author): Addressed Diego's comment: added prompt slice and example_id to the failure annotation, plus a small test to assert the extra fields are present.

Priya Nair: Can we make sure the CI hook exit codes are stable on transient infra failures? Suggest wrapping the runner with a retrier and differentiate gating failures vs infra errors in annotations.

Maya Chen: Added a 3-attempt retrier for transient failures and a distinct 'infra_error' annotation type. The CI job will be marked neutral when infra_error is observed so it doesn't cause accidental blocking.
Liam O'Connor: Approving after verifying unit tests and local run against a mock model. Observed one flaky test which was fixed in the follow-up commit.

release_notes: Add opt-in per-prompt CI gating for eval-harness. Teams can configure per-prompt thresholds to fail CI when individual prompt scores regress. Metrics emitted for per-prompt scores and pass/fail counts.
notes: This PR adds the core gating primitives. Follow-ups planned: - UI in Console to edit per-prompt thresholds (ENG-2173) - Automated experiments to suggest thresholds based on historical variance - Backfill of existing prompt baseline data into the metrics pipeline
